== Summary ==
Francis Lalumiere on the "The Daily Wrap-Up" button of Decipher's [[DecipherCon 1999]] home page (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach). The button sits under the heading "NOTES FROM LALUMIERE..." and links to his daily wrap-ups, each bylined "by Francis K. Lalumiere". Original size (200 × 50 pixels); no larger version was archived. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Francis Lalumiere]].
